aboutDialog.whyNameBody: Moji+ keeps the name of the original Moji—short, easy to remember, and evocative of characters and writing—and adds “+” for the changes it maintains on top of it.
aboutDialog.upstreamBody: Moji+ is a derivative of Moji by Alex Ishida, distributed under the MIT License. It keeps receiving the changes made to the original project and adds its own, maintained independently.

update.availableBody: Moji+ {{version}} is ready to download on GitHub Releases.

externalChange.modifiedBody: “{{name}}” was changed outside Moji+, and it has unsaved changes here. Reload discards your changes; Save As keeps both versions.
externalChange.deletedBody: “{{name}}” was deleted or moved outside Moji+. Save to recreate it, or save it under a new name.
externalChange.conflictBody: “{{name}}” was changed in another app since you opened it. Replacing it discards those changes.
externalChange.reloaded: “{{name}}” was updated with the version on disk.
